rationale_one_line: ECC is Anthropic-adjacent harness territory; warm-parchment Claude preset earns the lane, and a DISPATCH (last used 15 days ago) treats Affaan's ten-month build like a field report on the operator pattern winning.
writing_tone_notes: Cool, reportorial, dateline framing. Build-in-public peer-to-peer voice. Show the loop (ten months daily, one harness, now everyone's). Contractions where natural. Specifics over adjectives. Trust the reader.
do_rules: Lead the dispatch with a dateline frame (place + filing time)
Use a quote scene that sounds like the operator, not a marketing tagline
Land the fix beat at scene 4 (60-65% of total)
Treat numbers as evidence inside the dispatch, not the headline
dont_rules: Don't repeat star counts in scene copy (those land in the X caption)
Don't echo any tweet phrase verbatim in scene copy or Why-this-one
Don't break the wire-service register with hype words (superlatives, version numbers)
Don't use 'one harness' or 'ten months' identically in both tweet and scene copy
